PRONUNCIATION
Adding emphasis with auxiliaries
In the conversation, Gavin said that Nick and Carol's
flat 'does need a bit of work done on it, but they've
actually bought it'
We can add emphasis to sentences by either adding
the auxiliaries do, does or did - or by stressing the
auxiliary verb already there.

sentences below do you expect to be stressed?
